JobIntro_Knight_caption1--.name: People say the darkness has been wiped from our world... but I know\nwhat I've seen.

JobIntro_Knight_caption2--.name: There is darkness in the hearts of our people.

JobIntro_Knight_caption3--.name: The strong always tread upon the weak. It happened to me.

JobIntro_Knight_caption5--.name: The world still has heroes who can help the weak.

JobIntro_Knight_caption6--.name: A kind soul helped me on that fateful day, so I know they're\nout there.

JobIntro_Knight_caption7--.name: Those who can help and protect others are the people who make\nthis world great.

JobIntro_Knight_caption8--.name: I'm going to become one of those heroes...

JobIntro_Berserker_caption1--.name: People fear the unknown. My parents did.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption2--.name: The darkness in me drove them to abandon me.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption3--.name: If the old man hadn't found me and taken me in...

JobIntro_Berserker_caption5--.name: The old man didn't care about the power within me and raised me\nas his own.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption6--.name: History, science, art... he taught me so many things I didn't care about.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption7--.name: I found out later that he was once Maple World's greatest hero.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption8--.name: I should thank him for raising me, and teaching me to be strong.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption9--.name: And I'll surpass him, by becoming a stronger warrior!

JobIntro_Berserker_caption10--.name: New heroes are meant to eclipse those that came before.

JobIntro_Berserker_caption11--.name: Isn't that the best way to show respect for their efforts?

JobIntro_Berserker_caption12--.name: So get ready, old man! Today's the day I beat you!

JobIntro_Wizard_caption2--.name: What's this? We're one student short.

JobIntro_Wizard_caption4--.name: Professor! We have quite a lot of magic to learn today.

JobIntro_Wizard_caption5--.name: Are you going to waste our time waiting for one tardy student?

JobIntro_Wizard_caption6--.name: An astute point, as usual, Miss Class President.

JobIntro_Wizard_caption7--.name: Let's begin. What can anyone here tell me about monsters?

JobIntro_Priest_caption1--.name: After the darkness vanished 15 years ago, I thought my duty would be\nto pray and sing of our past glory.

JobIntro_Priest_caption2--.name: When I heard our peace was threatened again, a great fear grew\nin my heart.

JobIntro_Priest_caption3--.name: But along with that fear... was hope. Hope that I would find\nnew purpose.

JobIntro_Priest_caption4--.name: The guardian priests serve the will of the divine light.

JobIntro_Priest_caption5--.name: And so, it is my duty to bring glory to this land once more!

JobIntro_Ranger_caption1--.name: Not everything is as simple as it appears.

JobIntro_Ranger_caption2--.name: It's an easy truth to forget.

JobIntro_Ranger_caption3--.name: But no matter how hidden, the truth is always revealed in the end.

JobIntro_Ranger_caption4--.name: Sometimes, you get to see the real side of a person for just a moment.

JobIntro_Ranger_caption5--.name: A person who is stronger than anyone else, but keeps it hidden...

JobIntro_Ranger_caption6--.name: A person who never hesitates to help when they are needed...

JobIntro_Ranger_caption7--.name: A person whose footsteps I work hard to follow in.

JobIntro_HeavyGunner_caption1--.name: My whole life, people have told me...

JobIntro_HeavyGunner_caption2--.name: "Science alone cannot bring peace to Maple World."

JobIntro_HeavyGunner_caption3--.name: That is a reasonable hypothesis... if you're an idiot!

JobIntro_HeavyGunner_caption4--.name: The right technology? It can accomplish anything. It can break through\nany barrier. It can level any playing field!

JobIntro_HeavyGunner_caption5--.name: So, my faithful assistant... Who's going to fix the world?

JobIntro_Thief_caption1--.name: I can't remember anything about my parents.

JobIntro_Thief_caption2--.name: My earliest childhood memories are of cold, dirty alleyways.

JobIntro_Thief_caption4--.name: My friends were my family, the ones who stood by me.

JobIntro_Thief_caption5--.name: Even now, we live the way we want. Our limits are our own.

JobIntro_Thief_caption6--.name: No one can hold us back. I didn't choose the life of a rogue...

JobIntro_Assassin_caption2--.name: We are the vanguard of darkness led by the Dark Lord, one of\nthe Seven Commanders.

JobIntro_Assassin_caption3--.name: We have one mission: To eliminate everything that stands in\nthe way of the Black Mage.

JobIntro_Assassin_caption4--.name: As a Rook, my own thoughts and emotions were purged so that\nI could focus on my work.

JobIntro_Assassin_caption6--.name: I've begun to... feel again. And those feelings confuse me.

JobIntro_Assassin_caption7--.name: Am I really working toward a better world?

JobIntro_Assassin_caption9--.name: For once... I don't know what to do...

Common_Opening_caption1--.name: You've answered the call. Now hear the story!

Common_Opening_caption2--.name: It begins with two goddesses: one light, one dark.

Common_Opening_caption3--.name: They created many worlds, but Maple World was their\ngreatest.

Common_Opening_caption4--.name: In every realm, there must be balance.

Common_Opening_caption5--.name: But the goddess of light loved Maple World and warded it\nagainst the darkness.

Common_Opening_caption6--.name: Fearing this imbalance, the goddess of darkness lashed out.

Common_Opening_caption8--.name: The battle was long and brutal, but, with the help of her sages,\nthe goddess of light defeated her sister.

Common_Opening_caption9--.name: As the goddess of darkness fell, she unleashed her fury,\npoisoning Maple World with her power.

Common_Opening_caption10--.name: Unwilling to see her beloved creation destroyed, the goddess of light\nsacrificed herself to save it.

Common_Opening_caption11--.name: What remained of her power became the great protector,\nEmpress Ereve.

Common_Opening_caption12--.name: Ereve gathered seven heroes to stand against the darkness.

Common_Opening_caption13--.name: Try as they might, they could not stop their world's slow corruption.

Common_Opening_caption14--.name: Ereve and her sages created three relics with power over life, space,\nand time: the Lapentas.

Common_Opening_caption15--.name: These Lapentas could gather up the darkness and cleanse it all at once.\nSo they thought...

Common_Opening_caption16--.name: The day of their bold plan came, and the shadows pooled\nin one place...

Common_Opening_caption17--.name: Even as they cast their purification ritual, the sages were gripped\nby the darkness.

Common_Opening_caption18--.name: It took all of the Lapentas' power to protect Maple World from being\nutterly destroyed.

Common_Opening_caption19--.name: The ritual site was corrupted, the whole region becoming\na dreaded no-man's land.

Common_Opening_caption20--.name: Two of Ereve's heroes, Cerian and Balon, stepped forward.

Common_Opening_caption21--.name: They journeyed into this "Land of Darkness" on a mission to save\nanyone trapped inside.

Common_Opening_caption22--.name: There, they worked to complete the purification ritual... and,\nin doing so, they met their end.

Common_Opening_caption23--.name: The Land of Darkness was sealed away, where it could hurt\nno one else.

Common_Opening_caption24--.name: With their noble sacrifice, these two heroes had bought peace.

Common_Opening_caption25--.name: But now, the shadows stir once more, and this miraculous peace\nis nearing its end.

Common_Opening_caption26--.name: The time has come for champions to rise again.

Common_Opening_caption27--.name: This is a story of heroes.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption1-FameContents-.name: There's a chance we might be outnumbered.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption4-FameContents-.name: I see you've found new allies.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption5-FameContents-.name: They won't save you from me.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption10-FameContents.name: Hurry up, the ship's about to launch!

SkyFortress_Intro_caption11-FameContents.name: Flight checks complete—\nBut we still have crew on the ground!

SkyFortress_Intro_caption15-FameContents.name: Take us up!\nFire the XR shells, on my markl!

SkyFortress_Intro_caption19-FameContents.name: Karl, Luanna. Look there.\nThey really did it.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption20-FameContents.name: A new era dawns on Maple World.

SkyFortress_Intro_caption21-FameContents.name: Brave guardians, please watch over us from above.

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption1-LapentaF.name: Brighter than the stars in the night

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption4-LapentaF.name: Forget the darkness of the past\n(Rise up again)

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption5-LapentaF.name: And the trembling in your heart\n(Don't be afraid)

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption6-LapentaF.name: Your story has only just begun\n(Don't lose heart)

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption7-LapentaF.name: The future is calling\n(I'm right beside you)

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption9-LapentaF.name: That guiding light of hope\nis a promise

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption11-Lapenta.name: Stay true to yourself and your dream\nwill come to pass

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption12-Lapenta.name: It's far too soon for your story to end

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption13-Lapenta.name: Call out the name\nthat trembles on your lips

Lapenta_Frontier_Intro_caption14-Lapenta.name: Even when you have no voice,\nI'll hear your cry

KiliansTruth_caption2-EpicApocalypse01-.name: That's right. I am Kilian, the Wizard of Light.

KiliansTruth_caption1-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Were you surprised to see a hero who had vanished?

KiliansTruth_caption9-EpicApocalypse01-.name:
I traveled to the Dark Land with Baron,
 one of the Seven Heroes and my close friend.

KiliansTruth_caption7-EpicApocalypse01-.name: I think it's time to tell you the truth of that day.

KiliansTruth_caption5-EpicApocalypse01-.name: I can't blame you for being surprised.

KiliansTruth_caption6-EpicApocalypse01-.name: After all, I was once the leader of the Seven Heroes.

KiliansTruth_caption14-EpicApocalypse01-.name:
the seal was deteriorating faster than expected,
and I had to make a decision.

KiliansTruth_caption11-EpicApocalypse01-.name: That we needed the power of Empress Ereve to complete the seal.

KiliansTruth_caption12-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Baron departed for Tria to relay this message.

KiliansTruth_caption10-EpicApocalypse01-.name: And upon arriving there, we realized something.

KiliansTruth_caption13-EpicApocalypse01-.name: I stayed behind to monitor the situation, but

KiliansTruth_caption15-EpicApocalypse01-.name: I had to attempt the seal, even if it meant doing it alone.

KiliansTruth_caption16-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Even if it cost me my life.

KiliansTruth_caption19-EpicApocalypse01-.name: For the first time, I doubted the Empress.

KiliansTruth_caption17-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Fortunately, I succeeded in sealing it, but my mind was growing hazy.

KiliansTruth_caption18-EpicApocalypse01-.name: And then suddenly, I could no longer sense Baron's life force!

KiliansTruth_caption21-EpicApocalypse01-.name: What if the Empress, the symbol of light, had abandoned us...?

KiliansTruth_caption24-EpicApocalypse01-.name: The day when the spear of light turns not toward darkness, but toward us.

KiliansTruth_caption22-EpicApocalypse01-.name: In that moment, I saw it.

KiliansTruth_caption23-EpicApocalypse01-.name: A vision of the Empress's immense power destroying the world.

KiliansTruth_caption20-EpicApocalypse01-.name:
What if the Empress wasn't simply late,
but had ignored our plea entirely?

KiliansTruth_caption25-EpicApocalypse01-.name: The ruin that the light would bring upon us…

KiliansTruth_caption26-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Since that day, I have devised and carried out many plans to prevent the Empress's ruin.

KiliansTruth_caption28-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Empress Ereve... she must be sealed here.

KiliansTruth_caption27-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Of all those plans, the one I poured the most effort into is this—the Black Moon.

KiliansTruth_caption29-EpicApocalypse01-.name: You've seen the dark substances that recently appeared in Tria, haven't you?

KiliansTruth_caption34-EpicApocalypse01-.name: The hero of the past is dead.

KiliansTruth_caption33-EpicApocalypse01-.name: This is the only way to prevent that prophecy.

KiliansTruth_caption31-EpicApocalypse01-.name: They are proof of the ruin that will one day come!

KiliansTruth_caption30-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Those are the physical manifestation of the uncertain future that lay dormant within the Empress.

KiliansTruth_caption35-EpicApocalypse01-.name: All that remains for me is a desperate wish to prevent the world's destruction.

KiliansTruth_caption36-EpicApocalypse01-.name: Anyone who knows the prophecy cannot turn away from this truth.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption2-EpicRuinFromLig.name: You're not mistaken. I am Kilian, the Wizard of Light.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption1-EpicRuinFromLig.name: Were you surprised to see a hero who had long vanished?

KiliansTruth_cn_caption8-EpicRuinFromLig.name: That day, in order to seal Lapenta,

KiliansTruth_cn_caption7-EpicRuinFromLig.name: It's time to reveal the truth that has been buried for so long.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption9-EpicRuinFromLig.name: I traveled to the Dark Land with Baron, one of the Seven Heroes and my close friend.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption6-EpicRuinFromLig.name: After all, I was once the renowned leader of the Seven Heroes.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption5-EpicRuinFromLig.name: It seems hard for you to accept.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption10-EpicRuinFromLi.name: After reaching the Dark Land, we realized

KiliansTruth_cn_caption11-EpicRuinFromLi.name: that sealing Lapenta required the power of Empress Ereve.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption12-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Baron rushed to Tria to report this,

KiliansTruth_cn_caption13-EpicRuinFromLi.name: while I stayed behind to observe the situation…

KiliansTruth_cn_caption14-EpicRuinFromLi.name:
However, the seal was deteriorating rapidly,
and I had to make an immediate decision!

KiliansTruth_cn_caption15-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Even alone, I tried to complete the seal with my own power.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption18-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Suddenly, I sensed Baron's life force vanish!

KiliansTruth_cn_caption16-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Even if... it cost me my life.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption17-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Though I barely managed to seal it, I had expended too much power and was losing consciousness.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption19-EpicRuinFromLi.name: At that moment, for the first time, I doubted the Empress.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption23-EpicRuinFromLi.name: I saw a vision of the Empress using her immense power to destroy the world.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption21-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Could it be that the Empress, the symbol of light, had abandoned us...?

KiliansTruth_cn_caption24-EpicRuinFromLi.name: The day the spear of light points not at darkness, but at us,

KiliansTruth_cn_caption20-EpicRuinFromLi.name:
What if she hadn't failed to receive the message,
but had deliberately ignored our plea?

KiliansTruth_cn_caption27-EpicRuinFromLi.name: The one I poured the most effort into is this Black Moon.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption28-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Empress Ereve... she must be sealed.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption29-EpicRuinFromLi.name: You must have seen the dark substances that recently appeared in Tria?

KiliansTruth_cn_caption26-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Since then, I have devised and carried out many plans to stop the Empress from destroying the world.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption25-EpicRuinFromLi.name: we shall face Ruin from the Light…

KiliansTruth_cn_caption34-EpicRuinFromLi.name: The hero of the past is dead.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption33-EpicRuinFromLi.name: There is only one way to stop that prophecy from coming true.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption31-EpicRuinFromLi.name: This is proof that the end is coming!

KiliansTruth_cn_caption32-EpicRuinFromLi.name: The world will be destroyed by the light…

KiliansTruth_cn_caption30-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Those are the crystallization of the unstable future lurking within the Empress.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption38-EpicRuinFromLi.name: The time has come to decide.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption37-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Kid, the truth is now laid before you…

KiliansTruth_cn_caption36-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Anyone who has heard the prophecy cannot turn a blind eye to the truth.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption35-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Now, I will stop at nothing to prevent the world's destruction.

KiliansTruth_cn_caption39-EpicRuinFromLi.name: Follow the truth, or cling to lies…
